Real Elexon Insights `FREQ` (GB grid frequency) responses, used to test parsing. Fetched from `https://data.elexon.co.uk/bmrs/api/v1/datasets/FREQ` and kept byte for byte.

Contains BMRS data © Elexon Limited copyright and database right 2026

`freq-2025-10-26T00-45-00_01-15-00.json` and `freq-2026-03-29T00-45-00_01-15-00.json` cover 00:45 to 01:15 UTC on the two UK clock-change days (fetched 2026-10-21). They hold a reading every 15 s with no gaps or repeats.
